name: NoByte
blurb: 63 browser tools and 13 games that keep your data on your device, no uploads or accounts. A zero-dependency static site built from one tool registry.

name: Applyin
blurb: Scores a LinkedIn job against your real resume in a sidebar on the posting, returning fit, missing skills and a rewrite, from a grounded LLM pass over a credit ledger.

name: Sutham
blurb: Sorts household waste from a phone camera with no network, speaking English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil or Telugu. Built solo in 6.5 hours at the DeepMind hackathon.

name: SkopeLabs
blurb: Finds a reference image in video and shows the keypoints behind the decision, by pairing ORB descriptors with a RANSAC check rather than an unexplainable model.

name: Stocker
blurb: Puts NSE research inside Claude as quotes, screening, peer comparison and alerts, by exposing each capability as an MCP tool over free Yahoo Finance data.

name: CollabDocs
blurb: Resolves workspace and document permissions in one function instead of scattered checks, so an access question has exactly one place to read. Django REST, Postgres.
